title: Porcupine native message v1
description: Canonical producer encoding for one live message. Omit absent optional fields instead of sending null or empty selectors. Server authorization, UTF-8 byte budgets, identity policy and receipt handling also apply. This is not the stored event representation. Live responses require durability: durable means the SQLite journal committed; buffered means only validated memory admission and can lose pending events on worker failure. Discover this instance through get-event-input-contract or x-porcupine-acknowledgment on its /ingest/v1/schema. Durability is server response metadata, never a producer input.

x-porcupine-acknowledgments.durable: SQLite journal committed; receipts include original event_id and duplicate status.
x-porcupine-acknowledgments.buffered: Validated input rows admitted to bounded worker memory, including retries; receipts contain only message_id and uuid. Committed unique counts and duplicate status are unknown. Flush timers do not bound loss age during outages.

message_id.description: Stable producer ID. Omission requests a new ID on each live submission.

timestamp.description: Occurrence time in RFC 3339 with a timezone. Omission uses server receipt time in live capture.

actor_id.description: Original anonymous or known actor. Omit for an actorless event.

properties.description: Business values, including nested JSON and null values. Ordinary native properties are not interpreted as identity commands.

context.description: Capture-time metadata. Common conventions are documented in the native contract. Extensions are preserved, subject to the configured privacy policy.
